author: Murphh
body:
Looking for anyone who wants to play in the upcoming tournament!

Requirements:
1. Do you have a heartbeat?
2. Can you play on Dec. 23 starting at 12 EST?
You've passed the final evaluation! 

Next steps,
1. Accept invite to team HOME in avicus alerts
2. Accept tournament invite in avicus alerts
3. Join HOME discord (optional)
4. Show up to tournament discord channel and play your best!

Hope to hear from anyone soon!
